prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the recent price trend: momentum scores only 2 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: price behaviour, risk.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 8 points in favour and 7 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 63 of 100. The side that carries most weight is growth. That gives an educational rating of Overweight with high confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
